text: Parrot. Margo, the savvy detective, has been on the tail of the elusive art thief known as 'The Phantom' for years. In the original story, Margo finally catches The Phantom in a climactic encounter at the Louvre, revealing him to be her long-lost brother. Alternative Ending: Instead of a tearful reunion, Margo notices a small, colorful parrot perched on a nearby statue, mimicking the exact phrase The Phantom whispered to his accomplice moments before his capture. She realizes the bird was trained by the thief to act as a living recording device, a final taunt from a brother who knew she would never suspect a bird. Rather than arresting him, Margo lets The Phantom escape into the crowd, choosing to protect her family's secret while keeping the parrot as her new, albeit noisy, partner in solving future crimes.
